entries.t: ARCO-ERA5 (Analysis-Ready Cloud-Optimized ERA5 Zarr)
entries.d: ECMWF ERA5 hourly reanalysis 1940 to present on a 0.25 degree grid as chunked Zarr on Google Cloud Storage: 2 m temperature, wind, pressure, precipitation, radiation, humidity, geopotential and 37 pressure levels; time-series and map access without downloads.

a.n: Public GCS bucket, anonymous read; open with xarray + gcsfs/zarr (the HTTPS mirror https://storage.googleapis.com/gcp-public-data-arco-era5/ answered 200). Copernicus licence: attribution to the Copernicus Climate Change Service required.

entries.t: Cloud Classification 2016-present (raster 20 m), Europe, daily
entries.d: The Cloud Classification (CC) product is generated in NRT for the entire EEA38+UK area based on optical satellite data from the Sentinel-2 constellation. The product provides the extent of clouds and cloud shadows with a pixel spacing of 20 m x 20 m. Cloud detection is performed at a 120m spatial resolution.

entries.t: Fractional Snow Cover 2016-present (raster 20 m), Europe, daily

It is generated in near real-time at European scale based on optical satellite data from the Sentinel-2 constellation.

entries.t: Gap-filled Fractional Snow Cover 2016-present (raster 60 m), Europe, daily

The product provides the extent of the snow cover per pixel as a percentage (0% – 100%) with a spatial resolution of 60 m x 60 m.

entries.t: Sentinel-6 AMR-C Non Time Critical (NTC)
entries.d: The Sentinel-6 AMR-C Non Time Critical (NTC) product delivers high-precision, fully calibrated brightness temperature data at three microwave frequencies (18.7, 23.8, and 34.0 GHz). Optimised for long-term climate monitoring, the product enables accurate retrieval of wet tropospheric corrections and supports reanalysis and reprocessing applications. Data are structured by satellite passes and…

entries.t: Sentinel-6 AMR-C Short Time Critical (STC)
entries.d: The Sentinel-6 AMR-C Short Time Critical (STC) product provides medium-latency, calibrated brightness temperature measurements, used to derive wet tropospheric path delay corrections with improved accuracy. Data are organised by full orbital passes and delivered within 36 hours of acquisition. The product supports ocean modelling and data assimilation workflows, and is provided in NetCDF format.

entries.t: Sentinel-6 P4 Level 1B Near Real-Time (NRT)

The data are segmented into 10-minute granules per ground station pass and delivered within three hours of acquisition. The product is provided in NetCDF and BUFR formats.

entries.t: Copernicus Global Land Surface Soil Moisture
entries.d: The Copernicus Global Land Surface Soil Moisture product (CGLS SSM) displays the relative water content of the top few centimetres soil, describing how wet or dry the soil is in its topmost layer, expressed in percent saturation. Input for the product are the Sentinel-1 C-band SAR backscatter values. Further information can be found [here] ( and in Bauer-Marschallinger et al., 2018.

entries.t: Copernicus Digital Elevation Model (DEM)
entries.d: The Copernicus DEM is a Digital Surface Model (DSM) that represents the surface of the Earth including buildings, infrastructure and vegetation. The Copernicus DEM is provided in 3 different instances: EEA-10, GLO-30 and GLO-90. Data were acquired through the TanDEM-X mission between 2011 and 2015. The datasets were made available for use in 2019 and will be maintained until 2026.

The map can for example be used to calculate risk premiums for parametric insurance schemes. entries.t: SENTINEL1 Harmonic Parameters
entries.d: The Harmonic model describes the typical seasonal Sentinel-1 backscatter variation on a 20 m pixel level. It was designed as a smoothed time-series approximation, removing short-term perturbations, such as speckle and transient events (like floods for instance). Hence, the model is suited to discern the seasonal changes brought about by varying water content, e.g., inundation or soil moisture…

The data extends over 4.3 billion hectares of the global tropics. The data is derived from multi-temporal convolutional neural network models applied to Sentinel…

entries.t: WRI Tropical Tree Cover Extent (10m)
p: World Resources Institute / Global Forest Watch

entries.t: Deforestation alerts (RADD) Coverage
entries.d: This dataset is a deforestation alert product that uses data from the European Space Agency's Sentinel-1 satellites to detect forest disturbances in near real-time and to confirm alerts within weeks. The RADD (RAdar for Detecting Deforestation) alerts use a detection methodology produced by Wageningen University and Research (WUR), with support from the World Resources Institute, and are…

entries.d: This dataset enhances pantropical near-real-time forest disturbance monitoring systems by using a deep learning model to classify direct drivers of forest disturbances on a monthly basis. Produced by Wageningen University and Research (WUR), Laboratory of Geo-information Science and Remote Sensing, with support from Global Nature Watch (GNW), the dataset is built upon GNW's integrated disturbance…
p: Bart Slagter, Laura Cue La Rosa, Anika Berger et al. Rapid s

entries.d: This layer combines multiple forest roads datasets covering six Congo Basin countries: Cameroon, Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of Congo, Equatorial Guinea, Gabon, and Republic of Congo. The pre-2019 roads data are from Kleinschroth et al (2019) which combines crowd-sourced data from Open Street Map (OSM), manually digitized roads from the Logging roads initiative led by Moabi, the…

entries.t: Tiger Conservation Landscapes
entries.d: These three data sets, produced by WWF and RESOLVE, show the location of current tiger habitat and priority areas for habitat conservation. Tiger Conservation Landscapes: Tiger Conservation Landscapes (TCLs) are large blocks of contiguous or connected area of suitable tiger habitat that that can support at least five adult tigers and where tiger presence has been confirmed in the past 10 years…
p: *Tiger Conservation Landscapes* Dinerstein, E., Loucks, C.J.

entries.t: Google Open Buildings v3 (footprints, Africa, South and Southeast Asia, Latin America)
entries.d: About 1.8 billion building footprint polygons with confidence scores and Plus Codes, detected from 50 cm satellite imagery across Africa, South Asia, Southeast Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean; companion temporal 2.5D height raster for Africa.

a.n: Per-S2-cell CSV.gz on GCS (https://storage.googleapis.com/open-buildings-data/v3/, 200) and Earth Engine FeatureCollection GOOGLE/Research/open-buildings/v3/polygons. Licence CC-BY-4.0 and ODbL-1.0 (dual). Coverage box is approximate.

entries.t: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 (REST point query)
entries.d: Global digital soil maps at 250 m for clay, sand, silt, organic carbon, nitrogen, pH, bulk density, cation exchange capacity, coarse fragments and carbon stock, at six depth intervals to 2 m, with prediction quantiles and uncertainty.

a.n: GET ?lon=&lat=&property=&depth=&value=mean; no key, about 5 requests/minute. Depths 0-5, 5-15, 15-30, 30-60, 60-100, 100-200 cm. Use the bulk COG/VRT entry for polygons.

entries.t: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 (bulk COG / VRT)
entries.d: The same 250 m SoilGrids 2.0 global soil property maps as Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF and VRT mosaics, readable by window for an area of interest: clay, sand, silt, organic carbon, nitrogen, pH, bulk density, CEC, six depths.

a.n: Static files over HTTPS, no key; per-property folders with VRT mosaics (Homolosine projection) and tiled GeoTIFFs.

entries.t: Kontur Population (H3 hexagons, 400 m)
entries.d: Global population density on an H3 resolution-8 hexagon grid (about 400 m), combining GHSL, Facebook HRSL, Microsoft buildings, Copernicus land cover and OpenStreetMap; GeoPackage distribution on HDX.

a.n: HDX dataset page (200). Direct file: https://geodata-eu-central-1-kontur-public.s3.amazonaws.com/kontur_datasets/kontur_population_20231101.gpkg.gz (200, large gzip GeoPackage). Release dated 2023-11-01.

entries.t: Earth Observing-1 Advanced Land Imager (ALI) Level 1GST (L1GST) Product
entries.d: Level 1GST is terrain corrected and provided in 16-bit radiance values.
p: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center

entries.t: Earth Observing-1 Advanced Land Imager (ALI) Level 1T (L1T) Product
entries.d: Level 1T is precision terrain correction by incorporating ground control points from the GLS2005 dataset. Scenes with sufficient ground control data and satisfactory RMS error are processed to Level 1T.
p: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center

entries.t: Earth Observing-1 Hyperion Level 1GST (L1GST) Product
entries.d: Level 1GST is terrain corrected and provided in 16-bit radiance values.
p: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center

entries.t: Earth Observing-1 Hyperion Level 1T (L1T) Product
entries.d: Level 1T is precision terrain correction by incorporating ground control points from the GLS2005 dataset. Scenes with sufficient ground control data and satisfactory RMS error are processed to Level 1T.
p: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center

entries.t: Landsat Collection 2 Analysis Ready Data (ARD) Level-2 UTM Top of Atmosphere Brightness Temperature (BT) Product
entries.d: The Landsat Top of Atmosphere Brightness Temperature (BT) product is a top of atmosphere product with radiance calculated 'at-sensor', not atmospherically corrected, and expressed in units of Kelvin.
p: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center

entries.t: Landsat Collection 2 Analysis Ready Data (ARD) Level-2 UTM Surface Reflectance (SR) Product
entries.d: The Landsat Surface Reflectance (SR) product measures the fraction of incoming solar radiation that is reflected from Earth's surface to the Landsat sensor.
p: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center

entries.t: Landsat Collection 2 Analysis Ready Data (ARD) Level-2 UTM Surface Temperature (ST) Product
entries.d: The Landsat Surface Temperature (ST) product represents the temperature of the Earth's surface in Kelvin (K).
p: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center

entries.t: Landsat Collection 2 Analysis Ready Data (ARD) Level-2 UTM Top of Atmosphere (TA) Reflectance Product
entries.d: The Landsat Top of Atmosphere (TA) Reflectance product applies per pixel angle band corrections to the Level-1 radiance product.
p: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center

entries.t: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 UTM Surface Reflectance (SR) Product
entries.d: The Landsat Surface Reflectance (SR) product measures the fraction of incoming solar radiation that is reflected from Earth's surface to the Landsat sensor.
p: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center

entries.t: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 UTM Surface Temperature (ST) Product
entries.d: The Landsat Surface Temperature (ST) product represents the temperature of the Earth's surface in Kelvin (K).
p: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center

entries.t: Landsat Collection 2 Level-3 Burned Area (BA) Product
entries.d: The Landsat Burned Area (BA) contains two acquisition-based raster data products that represent burn classification and burn probability.
p: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center

entries.t: Landsat Collection 2 Level-3 Dynamic Surface Water Extent (DSWE) Product
entries.d: The Landsat Dynamic Surface Water Extent (DSWE) product contains six acquisition-based raster data products pertaining to the existence and condition of surface water.
p: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center

entries.t: Landsat Collection 2 Level-3 Fractional Snow Covered Area (fSCA) Product
entries.d: The Landsat Fractional Snow Covered Area (fSCA) product contains an acquisition-based per-pixel snow cover fraction, an acquisition-based revised cloud mask for quality assessment, and a product metadata file.
p: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center

entries.t: Meta and WRI High Resolution Canopy Height Map (1 m)
entries.d: Global 1 m canopy top height predicted from Maxar imagery with a deep-learning model calibrated on GEDI and airborne lidar, acquisition years 2009 to 2020; also the tree-cover mask and per-pixel uncertainty.

a.n: Public S3 (s3://dataforgood-fb-data/forests/v1/alsgedi_global_v6_float/): chm/, msk/ tiles indexed by tiles.geojson. No key.

entries.t: NASA EONET Natural Event Tracker
entries.d: Curated feed of ongoing and recent natural events with locations and dates: wildfires, severe storms, volcanoes, floods, sea and lake ice, dust and haze, drought, landslides, from NASA and partner sources.

a.n: GET /api/v3/events?status=open&category=wildfires&bbox=; no key (verified 200).

entries.t: NASA FIRMS Active Fire Data (VIIRS and MODIS)
entries.d: Near-real-time and archived active fire detections from VIIRS (375 m; Suomi NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21) and MODIS (1 km) thermal anomalies, with fire radiative power, brightness temperature and confidence; global, within about three hours of overpass.

a.n: Free MAP_KEY from firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/map_key; CSV by area, country or bbox, up to 10 days per call. VIIRS from 2012, MODIS from 2000.

entries.t: NASA GIBS Global Imagery Browse Services (1000+ layers)
entries.d: Pre-rendered, near-real-time and historical global image layers as WMTS/WMS/TMS tiles: MODIS and VIIRS true color, fires, aerosols, snow, sea ice, land surface temperature, precipitation (IMERG), vegetation indices, night lights. Visualization products, not analysis-ready values.

a.n: No key. Capabilities: https://gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov/wmts/epsg4326/best/1.0.0/WMTSCapabilities.xml. Colour-mapped imagery: good for display, lossy for measurement.

entries.t: NASA GIBS VIIRS Black Marble night lights (tiles)
entries.d: VIIRS Day/Night Band night-time lights imagery as map tiles, including the Black Marble composite and daily DNB at-sensor radiance layers from Suomi NPP, NOAA-20 and NOAA-21.

a.n: Layers VIIRS_Black_Marble, VIIRS_SNPP_DayNightBand_At_Sensor_Radiance, VIIRS_NOAA20_DayNightBand_At_Sensor_Radiance (verified in capabilities). Imagery for display; use VNP46 products for radiance values.

entries.t: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 and CERES point time series)
entries.d: Daily, hourly and monthly meteorology and solar-energy parameters at any point from NASA MERRA-2 reanalysis and CERES: temperature, precipitation, wind, humidity, solar radiation, from 1981 to near real time, tuned for agriculture and renewable energy.

a.n: GET ?parameters=&community=AG&longitude=&latitude=&start=&end=&format=JSON; no key (verified 200). MERRA-2 native grid is 0.5 x 0.625 degree.

entries.t: Open-Meteo Air Quality API (CAMS)
entries.d: Hourly air quality forecasts and recent history from Copernicus CAMS: PM10, PM2.5, carbon monoxide, nitrogen dioxide, sulphur dioxide, ozone, dust, aerosol optical depth, pollen (Europe) and the European and US AQI indices.

a.n: No key for non-commercial use. CAMS Europe 11 km (history from 2013), CAMS Global 40 km (history shorter).

entries.t: Open-Meteo Climate Change API (CMIP6)
entries.d: Daily climate projections 1950 to 2050 for any point from downscaled CMIP6 models (EC-Earth3P-HR, MRI-AGCM3-2-S, NICAM16, FGOALS, HiRAM, MPI-ESM1-2-XR, CMCC-CM2-VHR4): temperature, precipitation, wind, radiation, humidity.

a.n: No key for non-commercial use; answered 429 (rate limited) from the shared sandbox IP. Model native grids are 10 to 50 km.

entries.t: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 reanalysis)
entries.d: Hourly historical weather for any point from 1940 to a few days ago, served from ECMWF ERA5 and ERA5-Land reanalysis (plus CERRA over Europe and IFS 9 km): temperature, rainfall, snowfall, wind, pressure, radiation, soil moisture.

a.n: No key for non-commercial use; answered 429 (rate limited) from the shared sandbox IP, so expect throttling. ERA5 is 0.25 deg (about 25 km), ERA5-Land 0.1 deg (about 11 km); 9 km is the IFS option.

entries.t: Open-Meteo Flood API (GloFAS river discharge)
entries.d: Daily river discharge simulations and forecasts from the Copernicus GloFAS hydrological model at any point: current, historical since 1984 and forecasts up to seven months, with ensemble members.

a.n: No key for non-commercial use. GloFAS v4 on a 0.05 deg (about 5 km) grid.

entries.t: Open-Meteo Weather Forecast API
entries.d: Hourly and daily weather forecasts for any point: temperature, precipitation, wind, humidity, cloud cover, radiation, soil temperature and moisture, from national weather models (ICON, GFS, ECMWF IFS, HRRR, AROME) blended per location. Up to 16 days ahead plus recent days.

a.n: No key for non-commercial use (rate limited). Nominal global resolution is 11 km; 1 to 3 km regional models (ICON-D2, HRRR, AROME) are the best case. Past model runs: historical-forecast-api.open-meteo.com.

entries.t: Open-Meteo Marine Weather API (waves)
entries.d: Hourly ocean wave forecasts and history: significant wave height, period, direction, wind waves, swell, ocean currents and sea surface temperature from MeteoFrance and ERA5-Ocean wave models.

a.n: No key for non-commercial use. 0.08 deg (about 8 km) MeteoFrance wave model, 0.5 deg ERA5-Ocean.

entries.t: CLMS Burnt Area (BA) Global 300m daily V4 (COG)
entries.d: Maps burn scars, surfaces which have been sufficiently affected by fire to display significant changes in the vegetation cover (destruction of dry material, reduction or loss of green material) and in the ground surface (temporarily darker because of ash). Daily datasets are available at global scale, in the spatial resolution of 300 m, and within 24 hours after the satellite acquisition. They…

entries.t: CLMS Burnt Area (BA) Global 300m monthly V4 (COG)
entries.d: Maps burn scars, surfaces which have been sufficiently affected by fire to display significant changes in the vegetation cover (destruction of dry material, reduction or loss of green material) and in the ground surface (temporarily darker because of ash). In addition to the date of burn, the Burnt Areas version 4.0 provides the burnt fraction of the pixel. Monthly datasets are available at…

entries.t: CLMS Dry Matter Productivity (DMP) Global 1km 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Represents the overall growth rate or dry biomass increase of the vegetation and is directly related to ecosystem Net Primary Production (NPP), however with units customized for agro-statistical purposes (kg/ha/day). Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1 km and with the temporal extent from 1999 to June 2020.

entries.t: CLMS Dry Matter Productivity (DMP) Global 300m 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Represents the overall growth rate, or dry biomass increase, of the vegetation. It is directly related to ecosystem Net Primary Production (NPP) but expressed in kg of Dry Matter per hectare and per day (kg DM/ha/day). Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to the present.

entries.t: CLMS Evapotranspiration (ETA) Global 300m 10-daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides actual evapotranspiration, soil evaporation and canopy transpiration with some quality indicators. Estimates are provided for two evapotranspiration schemes and an Ensemble of models. The 10-daily estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of 300 m from November 2025 to present, derived from Sentinel-3 OLCI and SLSTR data.

entries.t: CLMS Fraction of Absorbed Photosynthetically Active Radiation (FAPAR) Global 1km 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Defined as half the total area of green elements of the canopy per unit horizontal ground area. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1 km and with the temporal extent from 1999 to June 2020.
k: fraction of absorbed photosynthetically active radiation

entries.t: CLMS Fraction of Absorbed Photosynthetically Active Radiation (FAPAR) Global 300m 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Fraction of Absorbed Photosynthetically Active Radiation. Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to present.
k: fraction of absorbed photosynthetically active radiation

entries.t: CLMS Fraction of Green Vegetation Cover (FCOVER) Global 1km 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Fraction of Green Vegetation Cover. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1 km and with the temporal extent from 1999 to June 2020.

entries.t: CLMS Fraction of Green Vegetation Cover (FCOVER) Global 300m 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Fraction of Green Vegetation Cover. Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to present.

entries.t: CLMS Gross Dry Matter Productivity (GDMP) Global 1km 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Equivalent to Gross Primary Production (GPP). Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1 km and with the temporal extent from 1999 to June 2020.

entries.t: CLMS Gross Dry Matter Productivity (GDMP) Global 300m 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Represents the total amount of dry matter produced by land plants per unit time through photosynthesis without taking plant respiration into account. Equivalent to ecosystem Gross Primary Production (GPP) but expressed in kg of Dry Matter per hectare and per day (kg DM/ha/day). Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from…

entries.t: CLMS Gross Primary Production (GPP) Global 300m 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Defined as the total amount of carbon fixed by plants through photosynthesis in an ecosystem in a given period of time, expressed in gC/m²/day. Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to the present.

entries.t: CLMS Heat Flux (HF) Global 300m daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides latent and sensible heat fluxes with one auxiliary information. Estimates are provided for each Sentinel-3 overpass in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from November 2025 onwards.

entries.t: CLMS Leaf Area Index (LAI) Global 1km 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Defined as half the total area of green elements of the canopy per unit horizontal ground area. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1 km and with the temporal extent from 1999 to June 2020.

entries.t: CLMS Leaf Area Index (LAI) Global 300m 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Defined as half the total area of green elements of the canopy per unit horizontal ground area. Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time, at global scale, in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to present.

entries.t: CLMS Land Cover (LC) Global 100m yearly V3 (COG)
entries.d: The Dynamic Land Cover product provides a primary land cover scheme at three classification levels with class definitions according to the Land Cover Classification System (LCCS) scheme. This Collection 3 includes global land cover maps at 100 m resolution for base year 2015 and subsequent years until 2019, including a base classification with 23 classes, versatile fractional cover layers and…

entries.t: CLMS Land Cover Map (LCM) Global 10m yearly V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides at global level information on different types (classes) of physical coverage of the Earth's surface, e.g. tree cover, grasslands, croplands, permanent water bodies, wetlands at 10 m spatial resolution for the 2020 base year. The data are updated annually and will be available for the 2020-2026 years. This dataset builds upon initiatives like the 100 m Copernicus Global Land Cover layers…

entries.t: CLMS Lake Ice Extent (LIE) Baltic 250m daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: On daily basis for Northern Europe classifies, in pixels, inland/freshwater bodies as 1) Fully snow-covered ice, 2) Partially snow-covered or snow-free ice, 3) Open water. The data is available in near real time in the spatial resolution of 250 m and with the temporal extent from March 2017 to June 2024.

entries.t: CLMS Lake Ice Extent (LIE) Europe 250m daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: On a daily basis, classifies pixels of Continental Europe freshwater bodies as 1) Fully snow-covered ice, 2) Partially snow-covered or snow-free ice, and 3) Open water. The data is available in near real time in a spatial resolution of 250 m and with the temporal extent from July 2024 to present, derived from NOAA-20 VIIRS.

entries.t: CLMS Lake Ice Extent (LIE) Global 500m daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: On a daily basis classifies pixels in Northern Hemisphere freshwater bodies into 1) Ice, 2) Open water, and 3) Cloud. The class Ice includes various types of ice, also snow-covered ice. The data is updated in near real-time with the spatial resolution of 500 m.

entries.t: CLMS Lake Ice Extent (LIE) Northern Hemisphere 500m daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: On a daily basis classifies pixels in Northern Hemisphere freshwater bodies into 1) Ice, 2) Open water, and 3) Cloud. The class Ice includes various types of ice, also snow-covered ice. The data is updated in near real-time with the spatial resolution of 500 m and with a temporal extent from April 2021 to August 2025.

entries.t: CLMS Land Surface Phenology (LSP) Global 300m yearly V2 (COG)
entries.d: Provides yearly Land Surface Phenology parameters describing when change happened in time and how intensive it was during key phases of the vegetation development cycle. Annual products are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of 300 m from 2014 to 2024.

entries.t: CLMS Land Surface Temperature (LST) Daily Cycle Global 3km 10-daily V3 (COG)
entries.d: Provides a statistical overview of the land surface temperature daily cycle for each 10-day compositing period and every geostationary sensor image pixel. The minimum, median and maximum LST are calculated for each of the 24 hours of the day. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 3 km and cover the period from January 2018 to the present.

entries.t: CLMS Land Surface Temperature (LST) Daily Cycle Global 5km 10-daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides a statistical overview of the land surface temperature daily cycle for each 10-day compositing period and every geostationary sensor image pixel. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and cover the period from 2017 to 2021.

entries.t: CLMS Land Surface Temperature (LST) Daily Cycle Global 5km 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Provides a statistical overview of the land surface temperature daily cycle for each 10-day compositing period and every geostationary sensor image pixel. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and cover the period from 2021 to present.

entries.t: CLMS Land Surface Temperature (LST) Global 3km hourly V3 (COG)
entries.d: Provides hourly land surface temperature from geostationary sensors observations. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 3 km and cover the period from January 2018 to the present.

entries.t: CLMS Land Surface Temperature (LST) Global 5km hourly V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides hourly land surface temperature from geostationary sensors observations. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and cover the period from July 2010 to January 2021.

entries.t: CLMS Land Surface Temperature (LST) Global 5km hourly V2 (COG)
entries.d: Provides hourly land surface temperature from geostationary sensors observations. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and cover the period from January 2021 onwards.

entries.t: CLMS Land Surface Temperature with Thermal Condition Index (LST-TCI) Global 3km 10-daily V3 (COG)
entries.d: Provides a statistical overview of the land surface temperature over each 10-day compositing period and every geostationary sensor image pixel, including a Thermal Condition Index. The minimum, median and maximum LST are calculated regardless of any specific hour of the day. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 3 km and cover the period from January 2018 to…

entries.t: CLMS Land Surface Temperature with Thermal Condition Index (LST-TCI) Global 5km 10-daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides a statistical overview of the land surface temperature over each 10-day compositing period for every image pixel, including a Thermal Condition Index. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and cover the period from 2017 to 2021.

entries.t: CLMS Land Surface Temperature with Thermal Condition Index (LST-TCI) Global 5km 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Provides a statistical overview of the land surface temperature over each 10-day compositing period for every image pixel, including a Thermal Condition Index. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and cover the period from 2021 to present.

entries.t: CLMS Lake Surface Water Temperature (LSWT) NRT Global 1km 10-daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides the temperature of the water at the lake surface. The near real time observations (every 10 days) are available at global scale at spatial resolution of approximately 1 km and with the temporal extent from 2016 to present, based on Sentinel-3/SLSTR data.

entries.t: CLMS Lake Surface Water Temperature (LSWT) Offline Global 1km 10-daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides the temperature of the water at the lake surface. The LSWT observations (every 10 days) are available at global scale at spatial resolution of approximately 1 km and with the temporal extent from 2002 to 2012, derived from AATSR instrument on Envisat.

entries.t: CLMS Lake Water Quality (LWQ) NRT Global 100m 10-daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides semi-continuous observations for a large number of medium and large-sized lakes, according to the Global Lakes and Wetlands Database (GLWD) or otherwise of specific environmental monitoring interest. 10-daily observations are available at 100 m spatial resolution with a temporal extent from 2019 to 2024, derived from Sentinel-2 MSI.

entries.t: CLMS Lake Water Quality (LWQ) NRT Global 100m 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Provides semi-continuous observations for a large number of medium and large-sized lakes. 10-daily observations are available at 100 m spatial resolution from 2024 to present, derived from Sentinel-2 MSI.

entries.t: CLMS Lake Water Quality (LWQ) NRT Global 300m 10-daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides semi-continuous observations for a large number of medium and large-sized lakes. 10-daily observations are available at 300 m spatial resolution with a temporal extent from 2016 to 2024, derived from Sentinel-3 OLCI.

entries.t: CLMS Lake Water Quality (LWQ) NRT Global 300m 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Provides semi-continuous observations for a large number of medium and large-sized lakes. 10-daily observations are available in near real time at 300 m spatial resolution from September 2024 to present, derived from Sentinel-3 OLCI.

entries.t: CLMS Lake Water Quality (LWQ) Reproc Global 300m 10-daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides semi-continuous observations for a large number of medium and large-sized lakes. The reprocessed archive provides 10-daily observations at 300 m spatial resolution based on MERIS sensor data with the temporal extent from 2002 to 2012.

entries.t: CLMS Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) Global 1km 10-daily V3 (COG)
entries.d: NDVI is an indicator of the greenness of the biomes. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1 km.

entries.t: CLMS Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) Global 300m 10-daily v3 (COG)
entries.d: NDVI is an indicator of the greenness of the biomes. Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to the present.

entries.t: CLMS Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) Long-Term Statistics (LTS) Global 1km 10-daily V3 (COG)
entries.d: Provides long-term statistics (minimum, mean, median, maximum) of the 10-daily NDVI at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1 km over the period from 2015 to 2025.

entries.t: CLMS Net Primary Production (NPP) Global 300m 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Defined as the net amount of biomass, or carbon, produced by plants per unit area and time, expressed in gC/m²/day. It is equal to the difference between the Gross Primary Production (GPP), i.e. the total amount of carbon produced through photosynthesis, and the amount of energy used for plant respiration. Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial…

entries.t: CLMS Snow Cover Extent (SCE) Europe 500m daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides for Europe daily updates of the fraction of snow cover on the ground (also in forested areas) per pixel in percentage (0% to 100%). The data is available in near real time in the spatial resolution of 500 m and with the temporal extent from March 2017 to present.

entries.t: CLMS Snow Cover Extent (SCE) Global 1km daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides daily global maps of the fraction of snow cover on the ground (also in forested areas) per pixel in percentage (0% to 100%). The data is available in near real time with a pixel spacing of about 1 km.

entries.t: CLMS Snow Cover Extent (SCE) Northern Hemisphere 1km daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides for Northern Hemisphere daily maps of the fraction of snow cover on ground (also in forested areas) per pixel in percentage (0% to 100%). The data is available in near real time with a pixel spacing of about 1 km and with the temporal extent from 2018 to present.

entries.t: CLMS Surface Soil Moisture (SSM) Europe 1km daily v1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides information on the relative water content of the top few centimeters soil, describing how wet or dry the soil is in its topmost layer, expressed in percent saturation. Daily observations are available for the continental Europe in the spatial resolution of 1 km and with the temporal extent from October 2014 to present.

entries.t: CLMS Snow Water Equivalent (SWE) Northern Hemisphere 5km daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides daily estimates of the snow water equivalent over the Northern Hemisphere in the spatial resolution of about 5 km.

entries.t: CLMS Snow Water Equivalent (SWE) Northern Hemisphere 5km daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Provides daily estimates of the snow water equivalent over the Northern Hemisphere in the spatial resolution of about 5 km.

entries.t: CLMS Soil Water Index (SWI) Europe 1km daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Quantifies the moisture condition at various depths in the soil. Daily observations are available for continental Europe in the spatial resolution of 1 km and with the temporal extent from January 2015 to 2025.

entries.t: CLMS Soil Water Index (SWI) Europe 1km daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Quantifies the moisture condition at various depths in the soil. Daily observations are available for continental Europe in the spatial resolution of 1 km from 2025 onwards.

entries.t: CLMS Soil Water Index (SWI) Global 12.5km 10-daily V3 (COG)
entries.d: Quantifies the moisture condition at various depths in the soil. 10-daily observations are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of 12.5 km and with the temporal extent from 2007 to present.

entries.t: CLMS Soil Water Index (SWI) Global 12.5km 10-daily V4 (COG)
entries.d: Quantifies the moisture condition at various depths in the soil. 10-daily observations are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of 12.5 km.

entries.t: CLMS Soil Water Index (SWI) Global 12.5km daily V3 (COG)
entries.d: Provides daily updates on the moisture conditions in different soil layers. The data are available over the globe at the spatial resolution of 12.5 km and with the temporal extent from January 2007 to 2025.

entries.t: CLMS Soil Water Index (SWI) Global 12.5km daily V4 (COG)
entries.d: Provides daily updates on the moisture conditions in different soil layers. The data are available over the globe at the spatial resolution of 12.5 km from 2025 onwards.

entries.t: CLMS Soil Water Index (SWI) Static Layers Global 12.5km V3 (COG)
entries.d: Provides static masks and ancillary files that aid in the analysis of the global daily Soil Water Index data, the global 10-daily Soil Water Index and the global Soil Water Index time series products.

entries.t: CLMS Tree Cover Density (TCD) Pantropical 10m yearly V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides pantropical tree cover density as projective tree cover in percent per pixel at 10 m resolution for the 2020 base year. The product belongs to the Copernicus Global Land Cover and Tropical Forest Mapping and Monitoring Service (LCFM) and builds upon initiatives like the REDDCopernicus, EO4SD Forest Monitoring and pan-European Vegetated Land Cover Characteristics. It advances tropical…

entries.t: CLMS Top-of-Canopy (TOC) Reflectance Global 300m daily V2 (NetCDF)
entries.d: Provides top-of-canopy reflectances derived from Sentinel-3/OLCI observations at global scale in the spatial resolution of 300 m on a daily basis.

entries.t: CLMS Water Bodies (WB) Global 100m monthly V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides monthly maps of permanent water body extent at global scale in the spatial resolution of 100 m.

entries.t: CLMS Water Bodies (WB) Global 1km 10-daily V2 (COG)
entries.d: Provides information about the surface extent covered by water on a permanent basis at global scale in the spatial resolution of 1 km, available every 10 days.

entries.t: CLMS Water Bodies (WB) Global 300m 10-daily V1 (COG)
entries.d: Provides information about the surface extent covered by water on a permanent basis. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of 300 m, available every 10 days, and with the temporal extent from 2014 to 2020.

entries.t: CLMS Water Bodies (WB) Global 300m monthly V2 (COG)
entries.d: Provides information about the surface extent covered by water on a permanent basis. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of 300 m, available monthly, from 2020 to present.

entries.t: Copernicus Global 30 meter Digital Elevation Model dataset.
entries.d: Copernicus Global 30 meter Digital Elevation Model dataset.

entries.t: Seasonal PPI Trajectories, 10-daily, UTM projection
entries.d: [EXPERIMENTAL] Plant phenology index (PPI) at 10m resolution for EU.

entries.t: Vegetation Phenology and Productivity parameters, yearly, UTM projection
entries.d: [EXPERIMENTAL] Copernicus High Resolution Land Vegetation Phenology and Productivity parameters at 10m on yearly basis from 2017 onwards for EU countries. This collection contains parameters of the first detected growing season.

entries.t: Vegetation Phenology and Productivity parameters, yearly, UTM projection
entries.d: [EXPERIMENTAL] Copernicus High Resolution Land Vegetation Phenology and Productivity parameters at 10m on yearly basis from 2017 onwards for EU countries. This collection contains parameters for season 2.

entries.t: Global landcover at 10m resolution for 2020.
entries.d: WorldCover provides global land cover products for 2020 at 10 m resolution, developed and validated in near-real time based on Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data.

entries.t: Global landcover at 10m resolution for 2021.
entries.d: WorldCover provides global land cover products for 2021 at 10 m resolution, developed and validated in near-real time based on Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data.

entries.t: Landsat mosaic (bi-monthly, v1.0.1)
entries.d: Global, cloud-free, and reconstructed historical Landsat spectral bands are provided at a spatial resolution of 30 meters and temporal resolution of bimonthly intervals from 1997 onwards. The dataset was generated using the GLAD Landsat ARD version 2 as the primary input for temporal aggregation and the imputation of missing values.

entries.t: Sentinel 5 Precursor
entries.d: Sentinel 5 Precursor imagery captured by TROPOMI sensor. This dataset only supports loading one band at a time.

entries.t: Sentinel-1 SAR GRD: C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar Ground Range Detected.
entries.d: The Sentinel-1 mission provides data from a dual-polarization C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) instrument. This collection includes the S1 Ground Range Detected (GRD) scenes, processed to a calibrated, ortho-corrected product. This collection is compatible with "sar backscatter" and "ard normalized radar backscatter" processes.

entries.t: Sentinel-2 L1C
entries.d: SENTINEL-2 is a wide-swath, high-resolution, multi-spectral imaging mission, supporting Copernicus Land Monitoring studies, including the monitoring of vegetation, soil and water cover, as well as observation of inland waterways and coastal areas. The SENTINEL-2 Multispectral Instrument (MSI) samples 13 spectral bands: four bands at 10 metres, six bands at 20 metres and three bands at 60 metres…

entries.t: Sentinel-2 L2A
entries.d: SENTINEL-2 is a wide-swath, high-resolution, multi-spectral imaging mission, supporting Copernicus Land Monitoring studies, including the monitoring of vegetation, soil and water cover, as well as observation of inland waterways and coastal areas. The SENTINEL-2 Multispectral Instrument (MSI) samples 13 spectral bands: four bands at 10 metres, six bands at 20 metres and three bands at 60 metres…

entries.t: Sentinel 3 OLCI
entries.d: Sentinel 3 imagery captured by OLCI sensor

entries.t: Sentinel-3 OLCI Land Full Resolution (NRT)
entries.d: This collection provides Sentinel-3 OLCI Level-2 Land Full Resolution products containing data on global vegetation, chlorophyll, and water vapor.

entries.t: Sentinel-3 OLCI Water Full Resolution (NRT)
entries.d: OLCI Level 2 Marine products provide spectral information on the colour of the oceans (water reflectances). These radiometric products are used to estimate geophysical parameters e.g. estimates of phytoplankton biomass through determining the Chlorophyll-a (Chl) concentration. In coastal areas, they also allow monitoring of the sediment load via the Total Suspended Matter (TSM) product. Full…

entries.t: Sentinel 3 SLSTR
entries.d: Sentinel 3 imagery captured by SLSTR sensor

entries.t: Daily global Sentinel-3 Land surface temperature at 1km resolution
entries.d: Experimental Daily global Sentinel-3 land surface temperature at 1km resolution. Land surface temperature is defined as the effective radiometric temperature of the Earth's surface "skin" in the instrument field of view. Here, "skin" is referring to the top surface in bare soil conditions and to the effective emitting temperature of vegetation "canopies" as determined from a view of the top of a…

entries.t: Sentinel-3 SYNERGY Aerosol Optical Depth
entries.d: This Collection provides the Sentinel-3 Synergy Level-2 Aerosol Optical Depth product, which is a downstream development of the Sentinel-2 Level-1 OLCI FR and SLSTR Radiances and Brightness Temperatures products. The dataset provides both retrieved and diagnostic global aerosol parameters at super-pixel (4.5 km x 4.5 km) resolution for all regions over land and ocean free of snow/ice cover…

entries.t: Daily global Sentinel-3 Synergy products at 300m resolution combining OCLI and SLSTR bands.
entries.d: [Experimental] Sentinel-3 SYNERGY products are created from a combination of OLCI and SLSTR Level-1B products (including both nadir and oblique views). The SYNERGY swath is then corresponding to the common area between OLCI and SLSTR swaths, restricted to the daylight part of the SENTINEL-3 orbit (i.e., where the sun zenith angle at satellite ground track is lower than 80°).

entries.t: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI UV Aerosol Index L2
entries.d: This Collection provides Sentinel-5P Level-2 AER AI products, which contains high-resolution imagery of the UV Aerosol Index (UVAI), also called the Absorbing Aerosol Index (AAI). Sentinel-5P has daily global coverage and a GSD of around 7.5km at the equator. The default resolution in openEO is higher to avoid data loss.

entries.t: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI Cloud Properties L2
entries.d: This Collection provides Sentinel-5P Level-2 Cloud products, which contains high-resolution imagery of cloud parameters. Sentinel-5P has daily global coverage and a GSD of around 7.5km at the equator. The default resolution in openEO is higher to avoid data loss.

entries.t: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI Formaldehyde HCHO L2
entries.d: This Collection provides Sentinel-5P Level-2 HCHO products, which contains high-resolution imagery of atmospheric formaldehyde concentrations. Sentinel-5P has daily global coverage and a GSD of around 7.5km at the equator. The default resolution in openEO is higher to avoid data loss.

entries.t: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI Nitrogendioxide L2
entries.d: This Collection provides Sentinel-5P Level-2 NO2 products, which contains high-resolution imagery of nitrogen dioxide concentrations. Sentinel-5P has daily global coverage and a GSD of around 7.5km at the equator. The default resolution in openEO is higher to avoid data loss.

entries.t: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI O3 Total Column L2
entries.d: This Collection provides Sentinel-5P Level-2 O3 products, which contains high-resolution imagery of total column ozone concentrations. Sentinel-5P has daily global coverage and a GSD of around 7.5km at the equator. The default resolution in openEO is higher to avoid data loss.

entries.t: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API
entries.d: Live query access to the full OpenStreetMap database: roads, buildings, land use, water, amenities, power lines, railways, boundaries and any tagged feature, by bounding box or area, using Overpass QL.

a.n: POST Overpass QL, no key; keep queries bbox-limited and respect fair-use. overpass-api.de did not answer from the harvest sandbox (egress proxy), maps.mail.ru/osm/tools/overpass answered 200; the agent already falls back across instances.

entries.t: Overture Maps Addresses
entries.d: Address points with street, number, postcode and locality for many countries, from open government and community sources.

a.n: GeoParquet on public S3 (s3://overturemaps-us-west-2/release/2026-09-23.1/theme=addresses/), no key; the URL is the bucket listing for the theme (verified for release 2026-09-23.1). Read with DuckDB/pyarrow and bbox-filter on the `bbox` column; the `overturemaps` CLI also works. Release id changes monthly.

entries.t: Overture Maps Base (land, water, land use, infrastructure)

entries.t: Overture Maps Buildings

a.n: GeoParquet on public S3 (s3://overturemaps-us-west-2/release/2026-09-23.1/theme=buildings/type=building/), no key; the URL is the bucket listing for the theme (verified for release 2026-09-23.1). Read with DuckDB/pyarrow and bbox-filter on the `bbox` column; the `overturemaps` CLI also works. Release id changes monthly.

entries.d: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC collection. It uses the ASPRS (American Society for Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing) Lidar point classification. See LAS specification for details. This COG type is based on the Classification PDAL dimension and uses pdal.filters.range to select a subset of interesting classifications. entries.t: USGS 3DEP Lidar Point Cloud
entries.d: This collection contains source data from the USGS 3DEP program reformatted into the COPC format. A COPC file is a LAZ 1.4 file that stores point data organized in a clustered octree. It contains a VLR that describes the octree organization of data that are stored in LAZ 1.4 chunks. The end product is a one-to-one mapping of LAZ to UTM-reprojected COPC files. LAZ data is geospatial LiDAR point…

entries.t: USGS 3DEP Lidar Digital Surface Model
entries.d: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC collection. It creates a Digital Surface Model (DSM) using pdal.filters.range to output a collection of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs, removing all points that have been classified as noise.

entries.t: USGS 3DEP Lidar Digital Terrain Model
entries.d: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC collection. It creates a Digital Terrain Model (DTM) using pdal.filters.smrf to output a collection of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs. The Simple Morphological Filter (SMRF) classifies ground points based on the approach outlined in Pingel2013.

entries.t: USGS 3DEP Lidar Digital Terrain Model (Native)
entries.d: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC collection. It creates a Digital Terrain Model (DTM) using the vendor provided (native) ground classification and pdal.filters.range to output a collection of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs, removing all points that have been classified as noise.

entries.t: USGS 3DEP Lidar Height above Ground
entries.d: This COG type is generated using the Z dimension of the COPC data data and removes noise, water, and using pdal.filters.smrf followed by pdal.filters.hag nn. The Height Above Ground Nearest Neighbor filter takes as input a point cloud with Classification set to 2 for ground points. It creates a new dimension, HeightAboveGround, that contains the normalized height values. Ground points may be…

entries.t: USGS 3DEP Lidar Intensity
entries.d: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC collection. It is a collection of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs representing the pulse return magnitude. The values are based on the Intensity PDAL dimension and uses pdal.filters.outlier and pdal.filters.range to remove outliers and noise.

entries.t: USGS 3DEP Lidar Point Source
entries.d: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC collection. It is a collection of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs representing the file source ID from which the point originated. Zero indicates that the point originated in the current file. This values are based on the PointSourceId PDAL dimension and uses pdal.filters.outlier and pdal.filters.range to remove outliers and noise.

entries.t: USGS 3DEP Lidar Returns
entries.d: This collection is derived from the USGS 3DEP COPC collection. It is a collection of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs representing the number of returns for a given pulse. This values are based on the PointSourceId PDAL dimension and uses pdal.filters.outlier and pdal.filters.range to remove outliers and noise. The values are based on the NumberOfReturns PDAL dimension and uses pdal.filters.outlier and…

entries.t: Sentinel 1 Level-1 Ground Range Detected (GRD)
entries.d: The Sentinel-1 mission is a constellation of two polar-orbiting satellites, operating day and night performing C-band synthetic aperture radar imaging. The Level-1 Ground Range Detected (GRD) products in this Collection consist of focused SAR data that has been detected, multi-looked and projected to ground range using the Earth ellipsoid model WGS84. entries.t: Sentinel-2 Level-2A
entries.d: The Sentinel-2 program provides global imagery in thirteen spectral bands at 10m-60m resolution and a revisit time of approximately five days. This dataset represents the global Sentinel-2 archive, from 2016 to the present, processed to L2A (bottom-of-atmosphere) using Sen2Cor and converted to cloud-optimized GeoTIFF format.

entries.t: TerraClimate
entries.d: TerraClimate is a dataset of monthly climate and climatic water balance for global terrestrial surfaces from 1958 to the present. These data provide important inputs for ecological and hydrological studies at global scales that require high spatial resolution and time-varying data. All data have monthly temporal resolution and a ~4-km (1/24th degree) spatial resolution. This dataset is provided…

entries.t: US Census
entries.d: The 2020 Census counted every person living in the United States and the five U.S. territories. It marked the 24th census in U.S. history and the first time that households were invited to respond to the census online. The tables included on the Planetary Computer provide information on population and geographic boundaries at various levels of cartographic aggregation.

entries.t: USGS 3DEP lidar point clouds (Entwine Point Tiles)
entries.d: Airborne lidar point clouds of the United States from the USGS 3D Elevation Program, hosted as Entwine Point Tiles on AWS, hundreds of project areas, ground/vegetation/building classified, ready for streaming windowed reads.

a.n: Public S3 bucket usgs-lidar-public (us-west-2): one EPT per project, e.g. USGS_LPC_CA_LosAngeles_2016_LAS_2018/ept.json (200). Project footprints: https://usgs.entwine.io/boundaries/resources.geojson (200). Density varies, typically 1 to 8+ points/m2. Read with PDAL (readers.ept) with a bounds window.

entries.t: USGS Earthquake Catalog (FDSN event service)
entries.d: Global earthquake catalog from the USGS ComCat: origin time, location, depth, magnitude and felt reports for events worldwide, queryable by time, magnitude and region; GeoJSON, CSV or QuakeML.

a.n: GET /query?format=geojson&starttime=&minmagnitude=&minlatitude=...; no key (count endpoint verified 200); 20k events per request.

entries.t: VIDA Combined Google-Microsoft-OSM Open Buildings (GeoParquet)
entries.d: Roughly 2.5 billion building footprints merged and de-duplicated from Google Open Buildings, Microsoft ML Buildings and OpenStreetMap, as GeoParquet partitioned by country on Source Cooperative.

a.n: Source Cooperative page answered 200; data at s3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/vida/google-microsoft-osm-open-buildings/geoparquet/by_country/ (anonymous S3; bucket host not reachable from the sandbox proxy).

entries.t: WorldPop Age and Sex Structures (100 m)
entries.d: Gridded population by sex and five-year age group (0-1 up to 80+) at 100 m, 2000 to 2020, for every country: children under five, women of reproductive age, elderly populations.

a.n: Catalog JSON, no key; per-country GeoTIFFs on data.worldpop.org.

entries.t: WorldPop Global Population Counts (100 m, 2000-2020)
entries.d: Gridded estimates of the number of people per 100 m cell for every country, 2000 to 2020, built from census and survey data with random-forest dasymetric mapping; unconstrained and UN-adjusted variants, plus 1 km aggregates.

a.n: Catalog JSON at hub.worldpop.org/rest/data (no key). Direct GeoTIFFs, e.g. https://data.worldpop.org/GIS/Population/Global_2000_2020/2020/PAK/pak_ppp_2020.tif (200). The api.worldpop.org stats service did not answer from the harvest sandbox.
